1124 AM CDT Mon Sep 14 2026

...FLOOD WATCH IN EFFECT THROUGH WEDNESDAY AFTERNOON...

* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
  possible.

* WHERE...Portions of central and south central Iowa.

* WHEN...Through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
  creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
  - Several rounds of showers and thunderstorms are likely from this
    midday today through tonight. While rainfall amounts in some
    areas will be modest, there will be pockets of heavier rainfall
    that may lead to flash flooding, especially if multiple rounds
    fall in the same area. In addition, several more rounds of heavy
    rainfall are expected later this week, from Wednesday onward, and
    this watch might need to be extended or succeeded by more watches
    later.


PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...

For the latest stream observations and forecasts refer to
weather.gov/desmoines/water.
